csv_scope_of_work: Virginia Tech's 2026-2032 Non-General Fund Capital Outlay Plan includes a capital project to renovate Campbell Hall. The renovation of Campbell Hall will include comprehensive updates to the building s interior, including residential rooms and bathrooms. The renovation will also ensure compliance with ADA standards.
